content: {"rules": ["Forecast models tend to overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment spikes often precede price corrections, indicating market overreaction.", "Model bias toward higher prices persists when sentiment is bullish but fades during bearish sentiment.", "Price mean-reversion is stronger after sustained upward forecasts, especially when sentiment declines.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends rather than diverging.", "Lagging forecasts show persistent overshoots, suggesting delayed response to sentiment shifts.", "Models should adjust downward when sentiment turns negative and price history shows downward momentum.", "Forecast calibration is critical when sentiment and price history diverge significantly over 18-day windows."]}
